architectural_decisions.rationale: The architecture implemented for the development of the Revivack project system is a microservices-based architecture. [...] In the case of this application, such services are executed in Amazon EC2 instances and are managed by Docker, which manages the execution of the containers.

Traefik acts as a reverse proxy and load balancer designed to manage incoming and outgoing HTTP and HTTPS traffic. [...] HTTPS encrypts the data transmitted between clients and the server, protecting the integrity and confidentiality of the information.

Next.js is a framework for building web applications that supports both client-side and server-side rendering. [...] Next.js offers an additional structure, features, and optimizations that allow building applications faster and without the need to configure tools manually.
Prisma is an ORM tool used to simplify database access and management. [...] Prisma facilitates interaction with databases by providing a typed API to perform queries and modifications.

The Component-Based pattern focuses on building the user interface by creating independent and reusable components. [...] This approach promotes modularity, code reuse, and maintainability, facilitating the management of the application.

The Observer pattern establishes a one-to-many relationship between objects, where a subject maintains a list of observers. [...] When the subject's state changes, it automatically notifies all its observers, allowing them to react appropriately.

The Singleton pattern ensures that a class has only one instance and provides a global access point to that instance. It is generally used to manage shared resources, such as configurations, logs, or database connections, where having multiple instances could lead to inconsistent states or inefficient resource use.
